articles.title: 5 Ways Telemedicine Improves Access to Care
articles.excerpt: How connected care can reduce distance and improve access across South Africa.
articles.bodyText:
Access to healthcare is not only about whether a clinician exists. It is also about whether a patient can reach that clinician at the right time, with the right information and without unnecessary friction.

Telemedicine can help close some of those gaps by connecting patients and clinicians remotely while supporting continuity of care between physical visits.
articles.author: Dr N. Patel
